description.value:
You have the ability to revert energy back to it's original form. In practice this is usually used to seperate fusions and release stolen energy.

As a Reation you when land an Unarmed Strike or Melee Technique or as an Action when you can touch someone, You may spend Stamina to do one of the following additional effects at the end of your attack:

  • Targets with the Fusion Tag are sperated into their base components for 5 Stamina.
  • You may reduce the Ki, Temporary Ki, and any other forms of Ki the target may have by 10x the amount of Stamina that you spend when you use this Trained Feature.
  • If a target has taken any Ki, HP, or Stamina from a creature in the last minute and the target still has them, you return them to their original owner.
